description: Sharpe, Sortino, Treynor, Jensen's alpha, information ratio and tracking error, M², Calmar and up- and down-capture ratios from return series.

annualized_return.description: Compound annual growth rate of the portfolio
annualized_return.title: Annualized Return

annualized_volatility.description: Standard deviation of the portfolio returns (n - 1) times sqrt(m)
annualized_volatility.title: Annualized Volatility

beta.description: Covariance of portfolio and benchmark excess returns over the benchmark's variance
beta.title: Beta

calmar_ratio.description: Compound annual growth rate over the maximum drawdown
calmar_ratio.title: Calmar Ratio

down_capture.description: Geometric mean portfolio return over the benchmark's, in periods the benchmark fell
down_capture.title: Down Capture

downside_deviation.description: Root mean square shortfall below the minimum acceptable return (n), times sqrt(m)
downside_deviation.title: Downside Deviation

information_ratio.description: Mean active return over its standard deviation, times sqrt(m)
information_ratio.title: Information Ratio

jensen_alpha.description: Annualized intercept: m times (mean excess return - beta * benchmark's)
jensen_alpha.title: Jensen Alpha

m_squared.description: Annualized risk-free return plus the Sharpe ratio times the benchmark's annualized excess volatility
m_squared.title: M Squared

max_drawdown.description: Largest decline of the wealth index from a peak
max_drawdown.title: Max Drawdown

sharpe_ratio.description: Mean excess return over its standard deviation, times sqrt(m)
sharpe_ratio.title: Sharpe Ratio

sortino_ratio.description: Mean return less the minimum acceptable return, over the downside deviation, times sqrt(m)
sortino_ratio.title: Sortino Ratio

tracking_error.description: Standard deviation of the active returns (n - 1) times sqrt(m)
tracking_error.title: Tracking Error

treynor_ratio.description: Annualized mean excess return over beta
treynor_ratio.title: Treynor Ratio

up_capture.description: Geometric mean portfolio return over the benchmark's, in periods the benchmark rose
up_capture.title: Up Capture

title: Risk-adjusted performance: outputs
